ltv_dti_notes:
Max CLTV depends on FICO, lien position, loan amount and occupancy.

**Owner occupied, 1st or 2nd lien:**
- 90% CLTV: FICO 740-850 up to $250,000, or FICO 720-739 up to $150,000. DTI capped at 45%. A second AVM (FSD of 13 or lower) is required at final underwriting to support the value; if it does not come back under that threshold the borrower must re-select an offer at 85% CLTV or lower. Skipped if a BPO is ordered.
- 85% CLTV: FICO 740-850 (1st lien to $400,000, 2nd lien to $350,000), FICO 680-739 to $150,000, and FICO 780-850 to $750,000 on an owner-occupied single family residence of 5 acres or less.
- 80% CLTV: FICO 660-679 to $125,000, 680-699 to $200,000, 700-719 to $250,000, 720-739 to $300,000, 740-850 to $375,000, 760-850 to $750,000.
- 75% CLTV: FICO 640-659 to $125,000, and any loan above $400,000.
- 70% CLTV: 3rd lien position (owner occupied only).

**Secondary and investment:** 80% CLTV in 1st lien position up to $400,000, 70% CLTV in 2nd lien position. Max 2nd lien for non-owner occupied.

**2-4 unit (multi-family):** DTI capped at 45%. 80% CLTV owner occupied, 70% non-owner occupied in 2nd lien.

**Segment and state caps:** Texas and New York 80%. Homes listed for sale 80% (and not eligible over $400,000 or in Texas). New Mexico owner occupied 1st lien 79.99%. Florida condominiums (including mid and high rise) 70%.

**Max DTI** is 50%, reduced to 45% on the 90% CLTV tiers, on 2-4 unit properties, and on the Near Prime tier.

ltv_dti_notes:
Max CLTV tops out at 80% on this program. There is no 85% or 90% tier.

**Owner occupied, 1 unit:** 80% CLTV at 740+ 1st lien to $400,000, 680-739 1st lien to $400,000, 740+ 2nd lien to $300,000, 700-739 to $250,000, 680-699 to $200,000, 680-739 to $150,000, and 660-679 to $125,000. 75% CLTV at 760+ to $750,000, 760+ 2nd lien to $400,000, 740-759 to $350,000, and 640-659 to $125,000. 70% CLTV in 3rd lien position (760+ to $150,000, 680-759 to $100,000).

**Non-owner occupied (second home and investment):** 70% CLTV throughout. 1st lien to $400,000 at 680+, 2nd lien to $250,000 at 760+, $225,000 at 720-759, $200,000 at 680-719.

**2-4 units:** DTI capped at 45%. Owner occupied 80% at 1st lien to $400,000, non-owner occupied 70%.

**Max DTI** is 50% on 1 unit and 45% on 2-4 units.

A CLTV above 70% and up to 80% requires a minimum loan amount of $110,000. Texas caps CLTV at 80% and is primary residence only. Maximum CLTV is also subject to the AVM FSD score.
